2761b585faaf.zh: ImageNet、ILSVRC 與 AlexNet ImageNet, ILSVRC, and AlexNet

211fed128aa3.zh: 2012 年，AlexNet 在 ImageNet 大規模視覺辨識挑戰（ILSVRC）上一舉奪冠，以巨大優勢碾壓傳統特徵工程，拉開了現代深度學習革命的序幕！AlexNet 繼承了 LeNet「先卷積池化、後全連線」的骨架，但將維度推向 224×224 RGB 與 1000 類，並藉由 ReLU 啟用、雙 GPU 分組平行、局部響應正規化（LRN）與重疊池化，向世界證明瞭深層神經網路的非凡威力。
211fed128aa3.en: In 2012, AlexNet won the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) in one stroke, crushing traditional feature engineering by a huge margin and raising the curtain on the modern deep learning revolution! AlexNet inherited LeNet's "convolution and pooling first, fully connected after" skeleton, but pushed the dimensions up to 224×224 RGB and 1000 classes, and with ReLU activation, two-GPU grouped parallelism, local response normalization (LRN), and overlapping pooling, it proved to the world the extraordinary power of deep neural networks.

fcd7dbe1debe.zh:
「AlexNet 並沒有發明全新的拓撲哲學，骨架依然是 LeNet；
為何僅僅將它加深加寬並搬上兩張 GPU，就能引爆歷史性變革？」 突破在於「訓得動」與「塞得下」！ReLU 擊潰飽和消失，雙 GPU 突破 3GB 視訊記憶體壁壘，ImageNet 提供百萬資料燃料！
The breakthrough was 'trainable & fittable': ReLU solved saturation while dual GPUs conquered memory limits!
fcd7dbe1debe.en:
"AlexNet didn't invent a brand-new topological philosophy; its skeleton is still LeNet;
so why did merely making it deeper and wider and moving it onto two GPUs ignite a historic revolution?" The breakthrough was in "trainable" and "fits in memory"! ReLU defeated saturation and vanishing, two GPUs broke through the 3GB video-memory wall, and ImageNet supplied a million images of fuel!

5e9064520aa2.zh: 2012 年主流 NVIDIA GTX 580 單卡僅有 3GB 記憶體，無法容納 AlexNet 的龐大張量。作者開創性地將網路各層特徵圖對半切分至兩張 GPU，僅在特定層（Conv3 與 FC）跨卡通訊。
5e9064520aa2.en: In 2012 a mainstream NVIDIA GTX 580 card had only 3GB of memory, which couldn't hold AlexNet's huge tensors. The authors pioneered splitting the feature maps of each layer in half across two GPUs, communicating between the cards only at specific layers (Conv3 and the FC layers).

140310015515.zh: 徹底捨棄傳統的 Sigmoid / tanh 飽和啟用函式，全面改用非飽和的 ReLU $f(x)=\max(0,x)$。正區間導數恆為 1，徹底解決了梯度消失問題。
140310015515.en: It completely dropped the traditional saturating sigmoid / tanh activation functions and switched entirely to the non-saturating ReLU $f(x)=\max(0,x)$. Its derivative is always 1 on the positive range, which completely solved the vanishing gradient problem.

ca96ccc8680a.zh: AlexNet 三大關鍵技術：LRN、重疊池化與損失函式 Key Technical Pillars: Local Response Normalization, Overlapping Pooling, & Softmax Loss

683233f36df2.zh: 🧬 局部響應正規化 (LRN · 式 (7))

f6a4777fc795.zh:
模仿生物神經「側向抑制」機制，在相鄰通道間抑制過強響應：
        $$b_{x,y}^{i}=\frac{a_{x,y}^{i}}{\bigl(k+\alpha\sum_{j=\max(0,i-n/2)}^{\min(N-1,i+n/2)}(a_{x,y}^{j})^2\bigr)^\beta} \tag{7}$$
        交叉驗證超參數：$k=2, n=5, \alpha=10^{-4}, \beta=0.75$。
f6a4777fc795.en:
Imitating the "lateral inhibition" mechanism of biological neurons, it suppresses overly strong responses across neighboring channels:
        $$b_{x,y}^{i}=\frac{a_{x,y}^{i}}{\bigl(k+\alpha\sum_{j=\max(0,i-n/2)}^{\min(N-1,i+n/2)}(a_{x,y}^{j})^2\bigr)^\beta} \tag{7}$$
        Hyperparameters chosen by cross-validation: $k=2, n=5, \alpha=10^{-4}, \beta=0.75$.

38bf3e2f07c3.zh: 傳統池化步幅等於窗寬（如 $2\times 2$ stride 2），無重疊。AlexNet 採用池化核尺寸 $3\times 3$、步幅 $2$，滑窗相互覆蓋，實證能有效抑制過擬合並降低 Top-5 錯誤率 0.4%。
38bf3e2f07c3.en: In traditional pooling the stride equals the window width (e.g. $2\times 2$ with stride 2), so there is no overlap. AlexNet uses a pooling kernel of size $3\times 3$ with stride $2$, so the sliding windows overlap each other; experiments showed this effectively curbs overfitting and lowers the top-5 error rate by 0.4%.

5fb2807a0cc1.zh: 🎯 多項邏輯迴歸損失 (Softmax · 式 (8))

1c621d4cced5.zh:
對目標類別 $\ell$，網路最大化第 $\ell$ 個神經元預測機率，轉化為慣用的最小化負對數目標：
        $$\max_{\theta}\mathbb{P}(y_i=\ell) = \frac{e^{o_\ell}}{\sum_{j=1}^{1000} e^{o_j}} \Longrightarrow \min_{\theta}\Bigl(-\frac{e^{o_\ell}}{\sum_{j=1}^{1000} e^{o_j}}\Bigr) \tag{8}$$
1c621d4cced5.en:
For the target class $\ell$, the network maximizes the predicted probability of the $\ell$-th neuron, which is turned into the usual minimization of a negative log objective:
        $$\max_{\theta}\mathbb{P}(y_i=\ell) = \frac{e^{o_\ell}}{\sum_{j=1}^{1000} e^{o_j}} \Longrightarrow \min_{\theta}\Bigl(-\frac{e^{o_\ell}}{\sum_{j=1}^{1000} e^{o_j}}\Bigr) \tag{8}$$

696ead72a2f8.zh: 📌 本單元核心總結：AlexNet 歷史啟示錄 Key Takeaways: AlexNet & The Deep Revolution
696ead72a2f8.en: 📌 Key takeaways of this unit: the historical lessons of AlexNet

ef7d54f3c9ed.zh: LeNet 的全面昇級： AlexNet 驗證了卷積神經網路在百萬級全綵大圖（ImageNet 1.2M, 1000 類）上的壓倒性優勢。
ef7d54f3c9ed.en: A full upgrade of LeNet: AlexNet demonstrated the overwhelming advantage of convolutional neural networks on millions of large full-color images (ImageNet 1.2M, 1000 classes).

979a4febbbae.zh: 八層架構約 6000 萬參數： 前 5 層卷積抽特徵，後 3 層全連線（4096-4096-1000）分類，全連線層佔據了超過 90% 的龐大參數。
979a4febbbae.en: Eight layers, about 60 million parameters: the first 5 convolutional layers extract features and the last 3 fully connected layers (4096-4096-1000) classify; the fully connected layers hold more than 90% of the huge parameter count.

bed2c4ef0932.zh: 硬體工程破局： 單卡 3GB 視訊記憶體不足，以雙 GPU 分組卷積平行突破硬體限制，奠定了深度學習軟硬體協同進化的傳統。
bed2c4ef0932.en: Breaking the hardware deadlock: a single card's 3GB of video memory wasn't enough, so two-GPU grouped convolution in parallel broke through the hardware limit, founding the tradition of hardware and software co-evolving in deep learning.

9fec0a355384.zh: 三大關鍵催化劑： 非飽和 ReLU 啟用加速收斂 6 倍；式 (7) LRN 實現側向抑制；窗寬 3、步幅 2 重疊池化抑制過擬合，成就 2012 年視覺革命的劃時代豐碑！
9fec0a355384.en: Three key catalysts: non-saturating ReLU activation speeds up convergence 6×; the LRN of Eq. (7) implements lateral inhibition; overlapping pooling with window width 3 and stride 2 curbs overfitting. Together they made the epoch-defining monument of the 2012 vision revolution!
